---
title: How to Configure SAML SSO
section: build
navGroup: Account setup & admin
description: Connect Alloy to your Identity Provider via SAML for seamless single sign-on
---

Follow these instructions to connect Alloy to your Identity Provider (e.g. Okta, Onelogin, Google Auth, or other competitors) via SAML, allowing your users to seamlessly login in without creating or remembering a password for their Alloy accounts.

First, you will need to create a configuration for Alloy in your Identity Provider's dashboard. Usually, this is called an "application" or "integration," depending on the identity provider in question.

See the provider-specific guides below, or follow the [Generic SAML 2.0](/docs/build/generic-saml-20) guide for any other identity provider.
